description: This file defines data models using Pydantic for an event management API, including attendee and event models with create, update, and response variants.

classes.name: IDModel
classes.description: Common ID response model with a unique identifier.

classes.name: AttendeeBase
classes.description: Base model for attendee information, including name and email.

classes.name: AttendeeCreate
classes.description: Model for creating an attendee, inherits from AttendeeBase.

classes.name: AttendeeUpdate
classes.description: Model for updating attendee details, with optional fields.

classes.name: Attendee
classes.description: Full attendee response model including associated event IDs.

classes.name: EventBase
classes.description: Base model for event details including title, description, location, start and end times.

classes.name: EventCreate
classes.description: Model for creating an event, inherits from EventBase.

classes.name: EventUpdate
classes.description: Model for updating event details, with optional fields.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Full event response model including list of attendee IDs.
